label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Track sections not loading in busy areas (Wanaka): the map's lines are painted into a fixed pool of textures, one per visible ground tile with lines (32-122 by phone memory). In a busy area every tile has lines, so the view can need more; tiles holding a texture kept it whatever came into view, and newly visible ground (often the nearest) stayed without tracks. Now tiles are ranked finest first, then nearest the view's centre, and a tile within the pool's size takes the texture of the visible tile that comes last; tiles left out are the coarsest and furthest. Reproduced and checked on the GPU (renderer/examples/overlay_priority.rs: fails before, passes after).

Long followed legs no longer drawn straight: the 3 s wait for the map's tracks is 20 s ("Finding the track…" on the drawing note), long legs read zoom-13 or zoom-12 tiles (at most 120) instead of giving up beyond about 15-20 km, and track is split only near the taps.

tests.kotlinJvm: all pass (new: long leg along a 32 km track; tile zoom chosen by leg length)
tests.rust: all pass; GPU examples on Vulkan (lavapipe): overlay_priority (new), overlay_pool, overlay_drape, waypoint_occlusion
